symptom: Spoken goodbye did not promptly return the device to standby
verified_bug: The late interaction classifier reset the already-spoken goodbye flag, forcing a wait for a second assistant transcript or the 20-second deadline.
changes: Keep assistant reply evidence that arrived after the user segment started, even when classification returns later.
Wait for recent spoken output, audibility and a bounded queue/DMA playback tail; continuous silent audio does not require a zero-length queue.
A confirmed farewell with no spoken reply can close after 5 seconds of non-audible waiting; the 20-second hard bound remains.
Add aggregate farewell state and content-free arm logs.
privacy: Synthetic speech only in isolated runtime with its own owner and in-memory history; no household source data
voice_style: One plain instruction for familiar, friendly everyday conversation; detailed vocal performance directives removed
limitations: Synthetic and software behavior do not establish family microphone or listening acceptance.
Playback tail uses bounded application telemetry, not sample-exact DAC readback.
